name: GearBeacon
releaseNotes: Features: exact variant watches, combined availability and price targets, stock and price insights, actionable Watchlist summaries, collection purchase plans, budgets, direct collection adding, archiving and Undo. UI/UX: Store-inspired Browse, collection preview cards, clearer alert settings, and Activity pagination. Fixes: verified collection saves, preserved purchase records and dialog focus, accurate variant prices, and current-schema standalone validation. Security: stronger password hashing, strict host validation, restricted service identities, and hardened Docker isolation. Upgrade: validated safety backup before schema v11; format-v7 recovery exports. See docs/RELEASE_NOTES.md for all changes since 1.0.0. Current dev additions: budget-aware collection alerts, smoother background updates, per-watch/collection delivery routes, delayed-alert context and expiry, and product freshness; dev upgrades use a validated safety backup before schema v13 and format-v9 exports. These additions are not in the published v1.2.0 downloads.
